{"requirements": [
{"id": 1, "text": "The player shall complete 33 levels successfully."},
{"id": 2, "text": "The board shall be 200 pixels wide horizontally and 300 pixels wide vertically."},
{"id": 3, "text": "The bricks and the paddle shall be rectangular blocks with a width of 20 pixels and height of 10 pixels. The ball shall have a diameter of 10 pixels."},
{"id": 4, "text": "At the beginning of each level, the ball shall start from the top left corner of the board and move downwards with a straight trajectory at a 45° angle and a speed of 5 pixels per second."},
{"id": 5, "text": "The player shall move the paddle in order to hit the ball, making it change its direction upward."},
{"id": 6, "text": "To successfully complete a level, the player shall break all bricks."},
{"id": 7, "text": "Bricks shall have a color (blue, red, gold) and can be sized single or double."},
{"id": 8, "text": "A brick shall be sized single (20 x 10 pixels) or double (60 x 10 pixels)."},
{"id": 9, "text": "Blue bricks shall be destroyed with one hit, red bricks shall require two hits, and gold bricks shall require three hits."},
{"id": 10, "text": "The first level shall be initialised with 50 blue, single bricks that are placed in the brick section of the board."},
{"id": 11, "text": "The paddle shall only move horizontally on the bottom of the board, controlled by the player using the left and right arrow keys. The paddle shall not go outside the board. When each level starts, the paddle shall reset to the center of the bottom border."},
{"id": 12, "text": "The ball direction shall change every time the ball hits the paddle or the border of the board (except for the bottom border) with the correct angle of reflection."},
{"id": 13, "text": "Every time the next level starts, the speed of the ball shall increase by a sufficient amount."},
{"id": 14, "text": "When the player finishes a level, the next level with a different brick arrangement and increased difficulty shall begin. Each level shall remove two red bricks and one gold brick."},
{"id": 15, "text": "The brick pattern and arrangement shall be randomly generated."},
{"id": 16, "text": "The player shall be given 3 lives."},
{"id": 17, "text": "The player shall lose a life every time the ball falls off the side of the board."},
{"id": 18, "text": "When the player loses a life but still has lives remaining, the level shall restart if possible. Once the player loses all lives, the game shall be over."},
{"id": 19, "text": "When the game is over, it shall be possible to start again from level 1 or end the game."}
] 
}
